note: Three numbered steps per trophy (165 total). Every step cites at least one source by number; the numbers match sources.json. Steps are written in our own words from the cited guides — no guide text is copied.

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order — the platinum unlocks the moment the last one lands.
Follow the 8-stop route: story first, strands second, then activities, collections, crime and the money grinds.
Check the in-game 100% checklist (Progress > Stats) before the final cleanup so nothing is left behind.
Start the story and play Gone Fishing, the opening mission, to its end.
The trophy pops when the mission completes — no extra objective is needed.
Do not use cheats on this save: cheats disable trophies and saving.
Play through every Chapter 1 story mission in order.
Before the chapter closes, meditate at the early Chapter 1 spot — it disappears permanently once Chapter 1 ends.
Make a manual save at the start of the chapter so you can go back if you miss the spot.
Play through every Chapter 2 story mission in order.
From this chapter Jason and Lucia can both be played, which opens most of the map's trophies.
Scan vehicles and study animals as you travel — both count toward the 100% checklist.
Play through every Chapter 3 story mission in order.
Start every Strangers & Freaks strand the moment it appears — the race against Yago closes in this chapter.
Heist trophies start opening from this chapter onward.
Play through every Chapter 4 story mission in order.
Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter — there is no mission replay.
Heist trophies continue to open in this chapter.
Play the story to its final mission.
Make a manual save right before the final mission — it is the last natural stopping point.
Finish the final mission; free roam stays open afterwards for cleanup.
Follow the story until the mission Breakfast Run appears.
Play Breakfast Run through to its end.
The trophy unlocks on mission completion — no side objective is required.
Follow the story until The Cartel Heist appears (Chapter 3 onward).
Play The Cartel Heist through to its end.
Heist missions cannot be replayed, so let the story carry you through each one.
Follow the story until the mission Child's Play appears.
Play Child's Play through to its end.
Named story missions unlock in order — keep pushing the main story.
Follow the story until the mission Headliners appears.
Play Headliners through to its end.
The trophy follows mission completion with no extra requirement.
Follow the story until the mission VCIA Takedown appears.
Play VCIA Takedown through to its end.
The mission takes place around the airport — a good moment to try the airport trophies nearby.
Follow the story until Operation Savage Glory appears late in the story.
Play Operation Savage Glory through to its end.
It arrives naturally if you keep the main story moving.
Open the 100% checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) once it appears after the story.
Finish the must-complete parts in full: Robberies, Underwater Discoveries, Shooting Ranges, Drone Races and Bret's Quests.
Do optional missions when they appear — the checklist bar is forgiving (about 60% true completion), but optional content that closes mid-story is not coming back.
Find a jump or ramp with a clean landing zone and repeat it in free roam after the story.
Land 250 stunts — air time and a clean landing both count toward the total.
Keep going to 300 stunts if you are chasing A Long Road, which wants more than the trophy does.
Visit each activity type once: ranges, races, arcade, bowling, fishing and the rest.
One attempt at each of the 9 types is enough — you do not need to win or master any of them.
Most types unlock as you explore the map, so try them as you travel.
Visit the Shooting Ranges and work through the 42 challenges.
Practice each weapon class until the gold time or score is comfortable.
Clear them one by one in free roam — ranges stay open and there is no missable window.
Find the Top Fun drone race locations — 14 in total across Leonida.
Learn each course's corners, then race for the win at every location.
Every drone race is also required for the 100% checklist, so this feeds A Long Road directly.
Enter races across Leonida — each distinct race counts once toward the 20.
Win 20 different races; a repeat win on the same route does not add to the count.
Vary the events instead of repeating one favourite route.
Follow the fishing thread through the side-story contacts until Cal's challenge is offered.
Take the fishing challenge as soon as it appears.
Beat Cal in the challenge to close the strand.
Find an arcade cabinet at an arcade in the city.
Start any arcade game and play it through to its end screen.
One full completion is all it takes — no high score is required.
Meet Andy and take his first mission when it appears.
Work through Andy's missions in order as they appear.
Finish his final mission to close the strand.
Meet Kenton and take his first mission when it appears.
Work through Kenton's missions in order as they appear.
Finish his final mission to close the strand.
Meet Billy and take his first mission when it appears.
Work through Billy's missions in order as they appear.
Finish his final mission — the strand stays available after the story.
Start every stranger strand the moment it appears on the map.
Do the strand tied to the race against Yago in Chapter 3 — it closes mid-story.
Complete 8 strands in total; the rest stay open after the credits.
Meet Randy and take his first mission when it appears.
Work through Randy's missions in order as they appear.
Finish his final mission to close the strand.
Meet Tyrone and take his first mission when it appears.
Work through Tyrone's missions in order as they appear.
Finish his final mission — no special requirement beyond the chain.
Meditate at every meditation spot the moment you see one — never walk past a spot.
Do the early Chapter 1 spot before the chapter closes; it is gone for good afterwards.
Work through all 10 locations until the PSN counter reads 18/18 (some guides count 15 — both versions are shown in the panel).
Follow Bret's strand and take his hunts as they are offered.
Track the unique animal Bret names for each hunt.
Take the animal down to complete the hunt — his quests must all be finished for 100%.
Pick up collectible cards wherever you find them across Leonida.
Keep track of which sets are incomplete and hunt the missing cards.
Complete 3 full sets — a set only counts once all of its cards are in hand.
Use WAiNK at locations as you travel — it is a travel checklist.
WAiNK at 100 locations; the count climbs as you cross the map for other trophies.
Pair WAiNK stops with card hunting and area exploration so one trip covers three lists.
Take on challenges as they appear — stunts, driving, combat and more.
Complete 50 challenges; they tick over naturally while you chase the other trophies.
Keep going to 70 if you are chasing A Long Road, which wants more than the trophy does.
Bring your partner along and build a 4-star wanted level together.
Break line of sight using back roads and water, and keep moving.
Escape together until the stars clear — do not split up mid-chase.
With your partner, plan a short route between three nearby shops.
Rob the three shops back-to-back, fast, without ever losing your wanted level between them.
If the stars clear mid-run the chain breaks — start the run over.
Scan every vehicle you meet — scanning counts toward discovery.
Discover 100 vehicles; scan early and often instead of leaving it for cleanup.
The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 vehicles, so keep scanning past 100 for A Long Road.
Pick a fight with a group of enemies standing close together.
Trigger Combat Focus once the group is in range.
Chain 5 takedowns before Combat Focus ends — a crowded spot with cover nearby helps.
Head to Vice City International Airport in free roam.
Find a plane on the airfield.
Take off without a flight plan — an unscheduled departure is the whole ask.
Find where the military keeps its Rhino tanks.
Take a Rhino and drive it out.
The trophy pops once you are rolling in the tank.
Pick a jewelry store and case it first — watch the sightlines and the staff.
Go in quiet, take what you came for, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
If you are detected the attempt fails — patience beats speed here.
Plan each bank vault, get in and out clean, and escape.
Rob 5 bank vaults in total, escaping each time.
Vaults are among the robberies the 100% checklist requires in full, so they feed A Long Road too.
Learn the armored truck routes through the city.
Intercept a truck, crack it open and grab the cash.
Break away before the response arrives — the escape is part of the trophy.
Travel through every region of Leonida, area by area.
Visit all 52 areas — the counter ticks as each new area is entered.
Pair exploration with WAiNK stops and card hunting so one trip covers three lists.
Find the illegal operation each gang runs somewhere in Leonida.
Rob one operation per gang — 9 gangs in total.
A repeat hit on the same gang does not advance the count.
Head to Ocean Beach early — the name points to a first-chapter moment.
Look for the cocktail spot with the view the description names.
Trigger not yet confirmed: do it as early as you can and check the cited guides for the latest word.
Find a vehicle showroom you can enter.
Try smashing your way out in classic style, as the description says.
Trigger not yet confirmed: no public guide pins the exact showroom or move yet.
Head to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Start a game and bowl through it.
Follow through to the end of the game — one full game at that alley is the ask.
Play alongside your partner through story and free roam.
Take on partner activities and shared moments as they come up.
The exact trigger is still being pinned down — watch the cited guides for the latest word.
Play the game normally — choices accumulate across dialogue, story decisions and the small calls in between.
Keep the stepper here to watch the count climb toward 500.
This is a pure long-haul counter: it grows while you play everything else.
The description hints at a second attempt succeeding where the first did not.
Replay the kind of moment that failed once and try it again.
Trigger not yet confirmed: no public guide pins the exact moment yet.
The description suggests a surprising or strange event somewhere in Leonida.
Keep playing and watch for the odd moment the name hints at.
Trigger not yet confirmed: check the cited guides for the latest word rather than guessing.
The description points to a melee drive-by that bowls people over.
Set up a drive-by with a melee weapon instead of a gun.
Trigger not yet confirmed: no public guide pins the exact setup yet.
Earn Marked Bills from robberies and jobs.
Feed the bills through your contacts steadily instead of sitting on them.
Launder $250,000 in total — the count climbs as you work the crime stops of the route.
Buy what you need for the other trophies — weapons, clothes, cars and upgrades all count.
Spend across all shops, not just one store.
The $100,000 total takes care of itself by the end of the route.
Earn cash through jobs, robberies and laundering.
Buy each garage property as soon as you can afford it.
The trophy pops with the eighth deed — keep some cash in reserve for the last ones.
Find vehicles you want to keep while exploring.
Register each one through the Scooter Bros app.
Repeat until 10 vehicles are on the books — it pairs with discovering 100 vehicles for Whip It Good.
